annotation.title_clean: ROBOGATE: Adaptive Failure Discovery for Safe Robot Policy Deployment via Two-Stage Boundary-Focused Sampling
annotation.title_en: ROBOGATE: Adaptive Failure Discovery for Safe Robot Policy Deployment via Two-Stage Boundary-Focused Sampling
annotation.summary_en: arXiv preprint presenting ROBOGATE, a simulation-based pre-deployment validation framework for learned robot manipulation policies. Two-stage adaptive sampling finds failure boundaries across 50,000+ Isaac Sim experiments on four robot arms, and benchmarks VLA policies, revealing a large cross-simulator gap (97.65% vs 0%).
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-stage sampling (LHS then boundary-focused) efficiently finds failure boundaries in an 8-dimensional parameter space
Logistic regression risk model reaches AUC 0.780 and yields a closed-form failure boundary
Evaluated over 50,000 experiments across Franka Panda, UR3e, UR5e, UR10e
Fine-tuned GR00T N1.6 scores 97.65% on LIBERO but 0% on 68 industrial scenarios in Isaac Sim
Proposes an open-source validation layer for Physical AI deployment
